display.description: Auth service SLO view: requests, latency, exchange, PDP, outbox, revision feed and legacy ingest (CHAOS-11221). Labels from the allowlist only. No data until the auth service takes traffic (phase 2). Lines are the CHAOS-11220 SLO table numbers; the alerts are in alerts/rules.yml group auth_slo.
display.name: Dev Health - Auth Service SLO (production)

display.description: Rate of auth-service requests by status_class.
display.name: Requests by status class

display.description: Increase of 5xx responses. The alert is AuthService5xx (any 5xx, 5m); the availability SLO is in the SLO table (CHAOS-11220).
display.name: 5xx requests

filter.expression: deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND status_class = '5xx'

display.description: POST /v1/authorize p95. SLO line 25 ms (CHAOS-11220 row 2; alert AuthzLatencyP95High).
display.name: Authorize p95

filter.expression: deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'POST /v1/authorize'

display.description: POST /v1/authorize p99. SLO line 75 ms (CHAOS-11220 row 2; alert AuthzLatencyP99High). Resolves to bucket edges: 0.075 needs the edge added by CHAOS-11220.
display.name: Authorize p99

filter.expression: deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'POST /v1/authorize'

display.description: POST /v1/token/refresh p95. SLO line 200 ms (CHAOS-11220 rows 3,4; alert AuthTokenLatencyP95High).
display.name: Token refresh p95

filter.expression: deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'POST /v1/token/refresh'

display.description: GET /.well-known/jwks.json. No alert: no target is set (CHAOS-11220 row 5).
display.name: JWKS rate and p95

filter.expression: deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'GET /.well-known/jwks.json'
deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'GET /.well-known/jwks.json'

deployment.environment = 'production' AND service.name = 'auth-service' AND listener = 'auth-api-http' AND route = 'POST /internal/v1/token/exchange'
